name: doubted-status-percent

finding.title: `statusText` can show 101% at the end of an upload
finding.description: The new status line prints `job.percentDone()`. In `UploadJob.kt` that method rounds `sent * 100.0 / total` up, and `sent` includes the multipart trailer bytes that `total` leaves out, so the last update of every upload reads 101% before the line changes to the done text.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/src/main/kotlin/app/ui/UploadStatus.kt b/app/src/main/kotlin/app/ui/UploadStatus.kt
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/src/main/kotlin/app/ui/UploadStatus.kt
+++ b/app/src/main/kotlin/app/ui/UploadStatus.kt
@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@
 /** The line shown under the progress bar while a file uploads. */
 fun statusText(job: UploadJob): String =
-    "Uploading ${job.fileName}"
+    "Uploading ${job.fileName} (${job.percentDone()}%)"
 
 fun doneText(job: UploadJob): String = "Uploaded ${job.fileName}"
